name: command_explore
prompt: Use attached original villager and Greek diorama as STYLE authority. Draw one simple game UI icon: a small ancient parchment scroll map with a SINGLE island coastline in muted teal, and ONE tiny ordinary FIVE-POINT star floating just ABOVE the scroll in the sky, visibly separate from paper. The star has five equal points like a simple celestial star, NOT four/eight directional points and NOT a compass rose. No compass instrument, compass rose, needle, bearing lines, grid, arrows, telescope, sextant, modern pin, routes, lettering or legend. Compact silhouette legible24px, distinct from ship/cargo icon. Soft Ghibli TWO-TONE CEL shading, flat cream parchment plus one simple muted shadow, flat teal map mark, fine sparse brown ink, no gradients, gloss, realistic texture, mottling, heavy outlines or tattered-edge decoration. White background, no shadow or extra props. Era constraint: ancient Greek Mediterranean setting. Depict plausible ancient materials, clothing, tools, vessels and architecture. No magnetic compass, compass rose/needle, telescope, sextant, modern globe/cartographic markings, GPS routes, modern location pins, medieval heraldry, modern footwear construction or modern clothing cuffs. Do not invent writing. Abstract action arrows/checks are UI glyphs, not historical equipment. Preserve required gameplay meaning without inventing an exact date.
